newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Australia captain Wade retires from national team.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Australia captain Wade retires from national team.

text.p: Australia soccer captain and midfielder Paul Wade has retired from the national team, ending an international career spanning 10 years.
Wade said his retirement will be effective from Friday, when Australia defend a 6-0 lead against Tahiti in the return leg of the Oceania Nations Cup final in Canberra.
The 34-year-old Canberra Cosmos player has won 83 caps for his country but was overlooked for the first leg in Papeete last weekend.

The former South Melbourne midfielder was one of the few home-based players to play for Australia throughout Eddie Thomson's six-year reign as national coach. Thomson resigned earlier this month to take a job with struggling Japanese J-League club Hiroshima.
